easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Yannik until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
